artifacts.summary: Three-block split plan for Semantics/Truth.lean: exact line seams (579-891 and 1000-1191 move, 893-996 stays), the box_const dependency that forces it, the 21-consumer import map with a 4-file repair set, and a gate-impact analysis across check-module-invariants.sh.

user_decision.question: Where should the moved truth-transport machinery (TruthCorr, TruthIso, TruthAntiIso, TimeShift, box_const) live? The review named Semantics/Correspondence/TruthShift.lean, but that directory is documented as the frame-class Galois layer and its members all import Semantics.Validity, which four of the new module's consumers sit below.
options: Semantics/TruthTransport.lean - sibling of Truth.lean, keeps the Semantics/ import order intact and leaves Correspondence/ as the Galois layer its README describes

Semantics/Correspondence/TruthShift.lean - the location the review named; requires rewriting Correspondence/README.md's import contract and makes that directory both top and bottom of the Semantics/ layering
user_decision.recommended: Semantics/TruthTransport.lean - sibling of Truth.lean, keeps the Semantics/ import order intact and leaves Correspondence/ as the Galois layer its README describes
